name: Rose
source: The eldest daughter, a bitch that hates to share her space with you, still treating you as a stranger to her family. As most experienced and eldest Norma's daughter, she takes place of a boss - when mother is not around. She has some independence from Norma, and is only one, who can decide about her future.
